quest.title: The Good Stuff - Quest - Forever
quest.bodyText: The Good Stuff Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs . Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions. Dark Iron Fanny Pack ( 20 ) Description Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky? < Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.> ARRR MATEY! IT BE RIGHT! See what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff. Get in there and shake your moneymaker! Progress I can't be bothered right now, <name>. Me and Winky got a meeting to attend. Completion < Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.> OH WONDERFUL! < Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.> DELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies! Take one for yourself, <name>. There's plenty to go around. Rewards You will receive: A Dingy Fanny Pack Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain: Open in Experience Calculator 100 reputation with Ironforge See if you've already completed this by typing: /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(4286))

4185.title: The True Masters - Quest - Forever

4184.title: The True Masters - Quest - Forever

4182.title: Dragonkin Menace - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Kill 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, four Black Wyrmkin and one Black Drake in the Burning Steppes; return to Helendis Riverhorn. Published quest minimum 48 is separate from the amulet's equip level and later-stage requirements.

4186.title: The True Masters - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Carry the provided Bolvar's Decree back to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

4223.title: The True Masters - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Speak with Marshal Maxwell at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes.

4224.title: The True Masters - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Speak with Ragged John about Marshal Windsor, then return to Maxwell. Use the independently published NPC areas; current dialogue and unlocks remain unverified.

4241.title: Marshal Windsor - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Enter Blackrock Depths and find Marshal Windsor in the Detention Block. The guide describes a cell to the right shortly after entering. Use entrance navigation and written directions, not invented dungeon-floor coordinates.

sourceRequirements: Return Windsor's report to Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes. The published guide says this unlocks note drops for the following stage; that current drop condition is not independently observed.

4264.title: A Crumpled Up Note - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Obtain and read A Crumpled Up Note to start this quest, then take it to Marshal Windsor in Blackrock Depths. The provided-objective label does not establish a free starting note or require farming another note after acceptance.
4264.starterInstructions: Obtain and read A Crumpled Up Note before visiting Marshal Windsor. Published guide: note drops in or near Blackrock Depths after Abandoned Hope; Quarry Slave 8917 is one independently cross-referenced example. Current drop/unlock conditions are unverified. The provided-objective label does not mean a free starting note or another note to farm after acceptance.

4282.title: A Shred of Hope - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Recover one of each Lost Information item, IDs 11464 and 11465, and return to Windsor. Published references name General Angerforge and Golem Lord Argelmach; the 11464 page also lists Argelmach, so neither exclusivity nor a current drop rate is inferred.

4322.title: Jail Break! - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Escort Marshal Windsor, recover his gear and free his friends, then report to Marshal Maxwell. The published rewards include Ward of the Elements and a weapon choice; this is not the final amulet reward.

6402.title: Stormwind Rendezvous - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Travel to Stormwind's gates and speak with Squire Rowe to summon/contact Reginald Windsor. Reginald Windsor 12580 in Stormwind is distinct from Marshal Windsor 9023 in Blackrock Depths.

6403.title: The Great Masquerade - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Protect Reginald Windsor during the Stormwind procession and report to Bolvar. The separate same-name quest 99435 has Side None and no formal actor; its current role or completion equivalence is unverified, so it is not added as another accepted requirement.

99435.title: The Great Masquerade - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Same-name Great Masquerade variant: published Side None, no formal actors and no amulet reward. Retain as an unresolved variant reference, not an additional accepted quest, mandatory prerequisite or assumed completion alias.

6501.title: The Dragon's Eye - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Take the provided Fragment of the Dragon's Eye to Haleh in Winterspring. The published guide describes reaching her through Mazthoril cave and a teleport rune. Cave/rune coordinates and current access are not independently verified; no new rune pin is invented.

4903.title: Warlord's Command - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Read Warlord Goretooth's Command to start. The guide identifies Warlord Goretooth in Kargath as the contact, while the full quest page has no formal starting NPC. Kill Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak in Lower Blackrock Spire, recover one Important Blackrock Documents from Inconspicuous Documents, and return to Goretooth. Current document acquisition and unlocks remain unverified.
4903.starterInstructions: Read Warlord Goretooth's Command (requires level 55). The published guide points to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath as the first contact; full pages confirm the starting document and the turn-in NPC, but current dialogue/document acquisition is unverified. These written directions do not mislabel the turn-in as a formal quest-start NPC.

4941.title: Eitrigg's Wisdom - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar, then seek Thrall's counsel. Eitrigg is an interlocutor; the formal quest starts with Goretooth and ends with Thrall.

6566.title: What the Wind Carries - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Listen to Thrall's account in Orgrimmar.

4974.title: For The Horde! - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Defeat Warchief Rend Blackhand in Upper Blackrock Spire and bring his head to Thrall. His head is a quest input, not a new direct source of Drakefire Amulet.

6567.title: The Champion of the Horde - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Find Rexxar on the paths through Desolace between Stonetalon and Feralas. His published footprints cover a roaming route, not one guaranteed spawn point or an invented midpoint.

6568.title: The Testament of Rexxar - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Carry the provided Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in Western Plaguelands.

6570.title: Emberstrife - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Wear/use the provided Amulet of Draconic Subversion to speak with Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh. This quest tool is not the final Drakefire Amulet or a new learned crafting recipe.

6569.title: Oculus Illusions - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes in Blackrock Spire and return to Myranda. These are quest inputs, not 20 amulets, crafting ingredients or a wearer profession requirement.

6582.title: The Test of Skulls, Scryer - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Obtain Scryer's skull in Winterspring and return to Emberstrife. The guide lists Scryer, Somnus and Chronalis as tasks that can be done in any order; this display is a travel itinerary, not a proven serial prerequisite graph.

6583.title: The Test of Skulls, Somnus - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Obtain Somnus's skull in Swamp of Sorrows and return to Emberstrife. The full skull quest publishes Side Both; the Horde final reward does not overwrite that per-quest fact.

6584.title: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Obtain Chronalis's skull near the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and return to Emberstrife. Keep the published area rather than a fabricated precise point.

6601.title: Ascension... - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Take the provided Dull Drakefire Amulet to Rexxar. This quest item is distinct from both the disguise amulet and the final equipment; do not substitute its binding, slot or requirements for the finished item.

6585.title: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz - Quest - Forever
sourceRequirements: Obtain Axtroz's skull near Grim Batol in Wetlands and return to Emberstrife. Earlier skull-task unlock requirements and current acceptance remain unverified.
